title: 高速馬達磁浮軸承
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。磁浮軸承屬高速轉子安全關鍵系統；只分析公開概念及合成數據，不指導超速、拆卸或實機增益調整。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

stages.title: 磁力與氣隙
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成磁力與氣隙；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete force and gaps through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 分辨徑向與軸向支承：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Separate radial and axial support: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分辨徑向與軸向支承，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate radial and axial support through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩個徑向軸承及一個軸向控制概念，數清受控自由度。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch two radial bearing stations and one axial control concept and count controlled degrees of freedom. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 畫出兩個徑向軸承及一個軸向控制概念，數清受控自由度。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Sketch two radial bearing stations and one axial control concept and count controlled degrees of freedom. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分辨徑向與軸向支承」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If separate radial and axial support disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分辨徑向與軸向支承」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for separate radial and axial support, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

Attraction grows as the rotor approaches a pole, requiring active stabilization; saturation and leakage are omitted. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

knowledge.text: 位移靠近一側會增加該側吸力，形成需控制抵消的負剛性。
knowledge.textEn: Motion toward one pole increases attraction, creating negative stiffness needing feedback.

knowledge.title: 辨識開迴路不穩定：證據
knowledge.text: 在簡化方塊圖給小擾動，觀察無回授時偏移擴大。
knowledge.textEn: Apply a small disturbance to a simplified block model and observe drift without feedback.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：簡化吸力 F≈kI²/g²，若電流固定而氣隙由 1.0 降至 0.8 mm，吸力增至 1/0.8²=1.5625 倍。轉子越靠近磁極吸力越強，顯示需主動穩定；此式忽略飽和和漏磁。 磁浮軸承屬高速轉子安全關鍵系統；只分析公開概念及合成數據，不指導超速、拆卸或實機增益調整。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: approximate attraction F≈kI²/g². At fixed current reducing gap from 1.0 to 0.8 mm raises force by 1/0.8²=1.5625. Attraction grows as the rotor approaches a pole, requiring active stabilization; saturation and leakage are omitted. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

quiz.question: 關於「辨識開迴路不穩定：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Identify open-loop instability: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
位移靠近一側會增加該側吸力，形成需控制抵消的負剛性。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Motion toward one pole increases attraction, creating negative stiffness needing feedback.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 位移靠近一側會增加該側吸力，形成需控制抵消的負剛性。 在簡化方塊圖給小擾動，觀察無回授時偏移擴大。
quiz.explanationEn: Motion toward one pole increases attraction, creating negative stiffness needing feedback. Apply a small disturbance to a simplified block model and observe drift without feedback.

steps.title: 辨識開迴路不穩定：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Identify open-loop instability: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識開迴路不穩定，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand identify open-loop instability through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「位移靠近一側會增加該側吸力，形成需控制抵消的負剛性。」的觀察。在簡化方塊圖給小擾動，觀察無回授時偏移擴大。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Motion toward one pole increases attraction, creating negative stiffness needing feedback. Apply a small disturbance to a simplified block model and observe drift without feedback. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 在簡化方塊圖給小擾動，觀察無回授時偏移擴大。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Apply a small disturbance to a simplified block model and observe drift without feedback. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識開迴路不穩定」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If identify open-loop instability disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「辨識開迴路不穩定」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for identify open-loop instability, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.
